endpoints.name: Inference backend - success
endpoints.description: Returns a healthy Azure OpenAI-style chat completion. APIM should return this response without retrying or tripping the backend circuit breaker.

endpoints.name: Inference backend - invalid request
endpoints.description: Returns a client error for an invalid inference request. APIM should pass it through unchanged without retrying or tripping the circuit breaker.

endpoints.name: Inference backend - authentication failed
endpoints.description: Returns a backend authentication failure. APIM should pass it through unchanged; operators should correct the backend credential or managed identity configuration.

endpoints.name: Inference backend - authorization failed
endpoints.description: Returns a backend authorization failure. APIM should pass it through unchanged; operators should correct the backend role assignment or authorization policy.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"Forbidden","message":"The backend identity is not authorized to invoke this deployment."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - deployment not found
endpoints.description: Returns a missing model deployment error. APIM should pass it through unchanged; operators should correct the backend URL or deployment name.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"DeploymentNotFound","message":"The requested model deployment does not exist."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - request timeout
endpoints.description: Returns an explicit HTTP 408. APIM should trip the responding backend circuit and retry another eligible backend, retaining 408 if the fallback chain is exhausted.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"RequestTimeout","message":"The backend timed out while processing the inference request."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - non-transient conflict
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 409 without Retry-After. APIM should treat the conflict as non-transient and return it after one backend attempt.

endpoints.name: Inference backend - transient conflict
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 409 with Retry-After: 1. APIM should retry another backend but should not open the responding backend circuit for this conditional conflict.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"Conflict","message":"A transient backend conflict occurred; retry after one second."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - capacity exhausted
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After: 10 to model exhausted inference capacity. APIM should trip the backend circuit and retry another eligible backend.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"RateLimitReached","message":"The backend deployment has exhausted its available capacity.","type":"tokens"}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - transformed PTU exhaustion
endpoints.description: Returns custom HTTP 499 to represent PTU exhaustion transformed from a backend 408. APIM should trip the backend circuit and fail over.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"PtuCapacityExhausted","message":"PTU exhaustion was transformed to the custom 499 response."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - internal server error
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 500. APIM should trip the backend circuit, retry another eligible backend, and normalize an exhausted fallback chain to HTTP 503.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"InternalServerError","message":"The inference backend encountered an internal error."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - bad gateway
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 502. APIM should trip the backend circuit, retry another eligible backend, and normalize an exhausted fallback chain to HTTP 503.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"BadGateway","message":"The backend received an invalid response from an upstream dependency."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - unavailable
endpoints.description: Returns HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 5. APIM should trip the backend circuit, fail over immediately, and return a generic 503 if every fallback is exhausted.

endpoints.name: Inference backend - gateway timeout
endpoints.description: Returns explicit HTTP 504. APIM should trip the backend circuit, retry another eligible backend, and normalize an exhausted fallback chain to HTTP 503.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"GatewayTimeout","message":"The backend did not receive a timely response from an upstream dependency."}}

endpoints.name: Inference backend - transport failure
endpoints.description: Accepts the request and aborts the connection before sending HTTP headers. This approximates a backend transport failure that APIM should retry and normalize to 503 when exhausted.
